lines.text: Is this spot new? Its fight began under skin that looked perfectly clear.
lines.phonemes: ɪz ðɪs spˈɒt njˈuː? ɪts fˈaɪt bɪɡˈan ˌʌndə skˈɪn ðat lˈʊkt pˈɜːfɛktlˌɪ klˈiə.

lines.text: Follow faces photo by photo, and more than a quarter of new red spots rise from skin that looked perfectly clear. So what was happening underneath?
lines.phonemes: fˈɒləʊ fˈeɪsɪz fˈəʊtəʊ baɪ fˈəʊtəʊ, and mˈɔː ðˌanə kwˈɔːtəɹ ɒv njˈuː ɹˈɛd spˈɒts ɹˈaɪz fɹɒm skˈɪn ðat lˈʊkt pˈɜːfɛktlˌɪ klˈiə. sˌəʊ wɒt wɒz hˈapənɪŋ ˌʌndənˈiːθ?

lines.text: Look beneath that clear skin, and the defence is already there, immune cells crowding the follicle, some as thickly as in a red spot.
lines.phonemes: lˈʊk bɪnˌiːθ ðat klˈiə skˈɪn, and ðə dɪfˈɛns ɪz ɔːlɹˌɛdi ðˈeə, ɪmjˈuːn sˈɛlz kɹˈaʊdɪŋ ðə fˈɒlɪkəl , sˌʌm az θˈɪkli az ɪn ɐ ɹˈɛd spˈɒt.

lines.text: It's easy to picture an infection. But this bacterium lives in skin with spots and skin without. What makes the spot is largely how your body answers it.
lines.phonemes: ɪts ˈiːzi tə pˈɪktʃəɹ ɐn ɪnfˈɛkʃən. bˌʌt ðˈɪs bæktˈɪəriəm lˈaɪvz ɪn skˈɪn wɪð spˈɒts and skˈɪn wɪðˈaʊt. wˌɒt mˌeɪks ðə spˈɒt ɪz lˈɑːdʒli hˌaʊ jɔː bˈɒdi ˈansəz ɪt.

lines.text: White cells flood in until the follicle's wall can give way, spilling the fight deeper. A squeeze often pushes it further, where a mark is more likely.
lines.phonemes: wˈaɪt sˈɛlz flˈʌd ɪn ʌntˈɪl ðə fˈɒlɪkəl ˈɛs wˈɔːl kan ɡˈɪv wˈeɪ, spˈɪlɪŋ ðə fˈaɪt dˈiːpə. ɐ skwˈiːz ˈɒfən pˈʊʃɪz ɪt fˈɜːðə, wˌeəɹ ɐ mˈɑːk ɪz mˈɔː lˈaɪkli.

lines.text: And the pus is that fight's fallen: white cells so small that ten in a row still wouldn't span this paper's thickness.
lines.phonemes: and ðə pˈʌs ɪz ðat fˈaɪts fˈɔːlən: wˈaɪt sˈɛlz sˌəʊ smˈɔːl ðat tˈɛn ˌɪnɐ ɹˈəʊ stˈɪl wˈʊdənt spˈan ðɪs pˈeɪpəz θˈɪknəs.

lines.text: So, is it new? No. It's the end of a fight that began out of sight.
lines.phonemes: sˈəʊ, ɪz ɪt njˈuː? nˈəʊ. ɪts ðɪ ˈɛnd əvə fˈaɪt ðat bɪɡˈan ˌaʊtəv sˈaɪt.

lines.text: Next: the light on your face, and where it really goes.
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: ðə lˈaɪt ˌɒn jɔː fˈeɪs, and wˌeəɹ ɪt ɹˈiəlɪ ɡˈəʊz.
